schedule.cloudAiFailed: Could not open the cloud-folder setup chat: {error}
schedule.cloudAiPrompt: Help me configure Cognia's encrypted scheduled backup using the {provider} desktop sync folder. Follow the provider's current official desktop-sync documentation at {docsUrl}; use browser automation or a relevant skill if available. Verify that the official desktop client is installed, signed in, and actively syncing. Then guide me to choose a dedicated Cognia backup folder inside the provider's local sync directory from Settings → Data & privacy → Backup & restore. Never ask me to paste account credentials, private local paths, recovery keys, or encryption secrets into chat. Explain that Cognia writes auto-key-encrypted files locally while the provider client performs cloud upload, and finish by verifying a backup file appears and sync completes without errors.
schedule.cloudFolderHint: Choose a folder managed by the provider's official desktop sync app. Cognia writes encrypted files locally; the provider uploads them.
schedule.enableHint: Runs while the app is open. Auto-key encrypted; no passphrase needed.

webdav.aiConfigureFailed: Could not open the configuration chat: {error}
webdav.aiPrompt: Help me configure encrypted WebDAV backup in Cognia for {provider}. Use the provider's current official documentation at {docsUrl}; if browser automation or a relevant skill is available, use it to inspect the settings screen and guide the configuration. Never ask me to paste a password, app password, encryption passphrase, private server URL, or other secret into chat. Explain where I should enter secrets locally, verify the correct endpoint and authentication method, have me use Test connection, save the settings, explain the separate zero-knowledge sync passphrase and its remember-on-device trade-off, then run Sync now and verify the result. If a required value is unknown, ask only for non-secret context and give precise provider-specific instructions.
webdav.allowInvalidCertificatesDescription: Use only for a self-signed certificate on a server you control. This disables certificate verification for this WebDAV endpoint and can expose credentials to interception.
webdav.allowInvalidCertificatesLabel: Allow an invalid or self-signed certificate

credentialHints.app-password: Use the account email or username plus a provider-generated app password.

webdav.description: Periodically upload an encrypted backup to a WebDAV server so another device can download and restore it. End-to-end encrypted with your sync passphrase.
webdav.passphraseHint: Session-only by default — re-enter each session, or opt into remembering it below. Encrypts the backup so the server never sees plaintext.
webdav.rememberPassphraseDescription: Stores the passphrase in this device's OS keyring so scheduled uploads and restore checks run unattended after a restart. Anyone who can unlock this device can then decrypt your synced data — leave off to keep it memory-only.
webdav.rememberPassphraseLabel: Remember sync passphrase on this device
